# CANDIDATE: BOS_RETEST_WICK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
After a break of structure (BOS) on the 5‑min chart, a retest that forms a bullish rejection candle (long lower wick) signals residual buying pressure and continuation of the new trend. This captures edge by entering long at retest of broken structure with precise wick geometry, avoiding false breakouts in choppy markets.

## Mechanism
Identify a BOS when price makes a new higher high (HH) and closes above the prior high. Wait for price to retrace to within 0.2×ATR of the broken level (the prior high) and form a 5‑min bar with a lower wick ≥ 0.6× bar’s total range and close in the upper third of the bar. Enter long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Stop at the low of the retest bar; target 1.5R; upon reaching 1R move stop to break‑even and trail the remaining position with a 15% trailing stop from highest close. Regime hint: Effective in trending markets when the 20‑period EMA ribbon is aligned (all EMAs sloping same direction) and VIX between 12‑22; avoid choppy periods where ribbon is flat or intersecting.
